research_questions.statement: How can graph neural networks capture long-range interactions for learning PDE solution operators with linear time complexity?

provenance.text_excerpt: MKGN has slight higher error on Darcy flow where linear spaces are near-optimal.

claims.statement: MGKN has slightly higher error on Darcy flow where linear spaces are near-optimal.

provenance.text_excerpt: For Burger's equation, when linear spaces are no longer near-optimal, MGKN is the best performing method.

claims.statement: MGKN is the best performing method on Burgers' equation.

provenance.text_excerpt: the error increases with the resolution since standard convolution layer are parametrized locally and therefore cannot capture the long-range correlations of the solution operator.

claims.statement: FCN is mesh-dependent and its error grows with resolution.

provenance.text_excerpt: The drawback is its quadratic complexity, constrain GKN from a large radius. Therefore GKN has higher error rates on the Burgers equation where long-range correlation is not negligible.

claims.statement: GKN has quadratic complexity, limiting its radius and performance on Burgers' equation.

provenance.text_excerpt: We develop the multipole graph kernel neural network (MGKN) that can capture long-range correlations in graph-based data with a linear time complexity in the nodes of the graph.

claims.statement: MGKN captures long-range correlations with linear time complexity.

provenance.text_excerpt: Since the solution manifold of (14) exhibits fast decay of its Kolgomorov n-width, linear spaces are near optimal hence it is not surprising that RBM is the best performing method.

claims.statement: RBM is the best performing method on Darcy flow due to fast decay of Kolmogorov n-width.

provenance.text_excerpt: It shows simple nearest-neighbor graph structures are insufficient.

claims.statement: GCN with nearest-neighbor connections is insufficient for capturing long-range interactions.

provenance.text_excerpt: MGKN achieves a constant steady state test error, demonstrating that it has learned the true infinite-dimensional solution operator irrespective of the discretization.

datasets.description: Linear second-order elliptic equation used for operator learning.
datasets.name: Darcy flow
datasets.version_or_split: 2-d, training size N=1000, testing size N=100

datasets.description: Nonlinear PDE with periodic boundary conditions, mapping initial condition to solution at time 1.
datasets.name: Burgers' equation
datasets.version_or_split: 1-d, viscosity ν=0.1, training size N=1000, testing size N=100

experiments_or_tasks: Analyze computational complexity theoretically and numerically.
Develop a multi-level graph neural network framework (MGKN) that captures interactions at all ranges with linear complexity, inspired by fast multipole methods.
Evaluate MGKN on learning solution operators for Darcy flow and Burgers' equation, comparing against baselines: NN, GCN, FCN, PCA+NN, RBM, GKN.
Test mesh-invariance by training on one discretization and testing on different resolutions.

methods.name: Multipole Graph Kernel Network (MGKN)
methods.protocol_description: A hierarchical multi-scale graph neural network that adds inducing points to capture long-range interactions, using a V-cycle algorithm for message passing, achieving linear time complexity.

methods.name: Neural Network (NN)
methods.protocol_description: Simple point-wise feedforward neural network, mesh-free but lacks neighbor information.

methods.name: Graph Convolution Network (GCN)
methods.protocol_description: Graph neural network with naive nearest neighbor connections, following architecture in [4].

methods.name: PCA+NN
methods.protocol_description: PCA autoencoder on input/output data with neural network interpolation of latent spaces [11], mesh-independent but evaluates only on training mesh.

methods.name: Reduced Basis Method (RBM)
methods.protocol_description: Classical reduced order modeling using linear basis functions, requires variational form of the problem.

methods.name: Graph Kernel Network (GKN)
methods.protocol_description: Graph kernel network with radius r=0.25 and m=300, similar to MGKN but without multi-level graph extension, quadratic complexity.

study_units.name: Multipole Graph Kernel Network (MGKN) development and evaluation
